app.name: Olai
app.tagline: Understand, compare, and navigate your legal documents.
app.disclaimer: Olai explains documents. It is not a lawyer and does not give legal advice.
lang.label: Language
action.deleteAllConfirm: This permanently clears all documents and results from memory. Continue?
onboarding.title: Welcome to Olai
onboarding.intro: Olai helps you understand a legal notice and your agreement, compare them, and see your next steps. Everything stays on your computer.
onboarding.privacy: Your documents are kept only in memory and are never saved to disk. Only text needed for analysis is sent, over an encrypted connection, to the AI model. You can delete everything at any time.
onboarding.apiKeyHelp: Stored securely in Windows Credential Manager. Leave blank to explore the offline demo.
tier.needsLawyer: Needs a lawyer or legal aid
tier.needsLawyer.detail: Because of what Olai found, this situation should be reviewed by a lawyer or a free legal-aid service.
tier.reason.courtOrPolice: This looks like a court or police document.
tier.reason.shortDeadline: There is a deadline within 7 days.
tier.reason.strategyQuestion: You asked about strategy or the outcome.
paper.title: What this document is
deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.howCalculated: How this date was worked out
deadline.needAnchor: Olai needs the date you received the notice to work out this deadline.
conflicts.title: Conflicts found
conflicts.count: {n} conflict(s) between the notice and your agreement
conflicts.none: No conflicts were found, or there is no agreement to compare.
severity.label: Severity
actions.title: Your checklist
citation.title: Citation
citation.notConfirmedHelp: Olai could not match this to the document text, so it is shown greyed out and not treated as fact.
ask.title: Ask about your documents
ask.placeholder: e.g. What is the notice period in my agreement?
ask.empty: Answers come only from your documents. Olai will say when it doesn't know.
reply.title: Draft reply
reply.intro: A neutral draft you can edit. It does not admit or deny anything.
reply.empty: Generate a neutral reply based on your documents.
missing.title: Information Olai still needs
compare.title: Compare
compare.navHint: Use J and K to move between conflicts.
findings.title: Flagged text
findings.intro: Olai found text that looks like hidden characters or instructions aimed at the AI. It was treated as data only.
progress.title: Analysing your documents
opendocs.title: Open your documents
opendocs.limits: PDF, PNG, or JPG. Up to 3 files, 15 pages, 20 MB each.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
